crs_and_units: Source data use EPSG:4326 (WGS 84), with coordinates in degrees. EPSG:32612 is recommended for analysis requiring metres.
changed_variable: Spatial predicate changed from within to intersect. Both produced 5 matched facilities, so the recommendation did not change.
privacy_and_governance_review: The supplied data are fictional course data and contain no real personal or sensitive locations. Real-world use would require verified data authority, privacy review, community-impact consideration, and appropriate Indigenous data governance where applicable.
